name: Self-Adjusting RSI Bands
note: Replaces the fixed 70/30 pair with 50 +/- mult times the dispersion of the RSI itself, recomputed every bar, so 'extreme' means the same statistical thing on every ticker and in every regime. est=0 uses the RSI's rolling standard deviation, est=1 its mean absolute deviation. mode=0 is the breakout reading (buy the cross ABOVE the upper band), mode=1 the fade (buy the cross back above the lower band).
source: TradingView open-source: 'Self-Adjusting RSI (SARSI)' by everget. Exact Pine read from github.com/everget/tradingview-pinescript-indicators/blob/master/oscillators/self_adjusting_rsi.pine
